### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via sys_oauth_application (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via sys_oauth_application (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx`  _(via sys_oauth_application (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8f59304ddc45825f1f4d63f6956e07a75df68c9d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `38239eff8efa57feb8e58facd251bee64623a835` — the merge of head `a72b7acf8fc300caa0466ec481711a79b7c06fd8` into base `8f59304ddc45825f1f4d63f6956e07a75df68c9d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 38239eff8efa57feb8e58facd251bee64623a835 && git checkout 38239eff8efa57feb8e58facd251bee64623a835
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8f59304ddc45825f1f4d63f6956e07a75df68c9d a72b7acf8fc300caa0466ec481711a79b7c06fd8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8f59304ddc45825f1f4d63f6956e07a75df68c9d && git merge --no-ff a72b7acf8fc300caa0466ec481711a79b7c06fd8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8f59304ddc45825f1f4d63f6956e07a75df68c9d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8f59304ddc45825f1f4d63f6956e07a75df68c9d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a72b7acf8fc300caa0466ec481711a79b7c06fd8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-oauth-application.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.objects.generated.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/es-ES.objects.generated.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ja-JP.objects.generated.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/oauth-register-form-types.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-oauth-application.type-options.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-application-type-column.test.ts, .changeset/24773-oauth-form-types.md, .changeset/25053-oauth-application-type-options.md + packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-schema-config.ts (`AUTH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SCHEMA`, `applicationType: 'type'`), packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts (the register wrapper and the toggle-disabled bridge), packages/runtime/src/api-exposure.ts (`apiMethods`, the 405), the installed `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.3 `dist/authorize-9whjxVLJ.mjs` (`checkOAuthClient`, `persistOAuthClientRegistration`, both update paths), packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts (`selectWithOptions`, `toSnakeCase`), packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts (the select arm, `validateRecordInScope`), packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (`applyFieldDefaults` and its insert and update call sites), packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts (`options` emits no DDL), the three `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` companions, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts, objectui packages/fields/src/index.tsx at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `cf153eb2e` (`SelectCellRenderer`), .changeset/24813-adopt-orphans-readonly-package.md and .changeset/24773-oauth-type-refusal.md (the BREAKING-minor shape), scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs (`readArmToken`), the headers of scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs and scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, and the Check Changeset job log on this head

Isolated contract review (narrowing face) of PR #25099 for card #25053, rendered 2026-10-21T10:19Z. Inputs: the card's body and both comments (the claim `6311507729` and the dev report `6313194098`; no patch-round report is posted for `a72b7acf8`); card #24773's body and all 18 comments; PR #25038, its file list and its contract review `6308302124`; #25013 as context; the PR body, its 10-path file list, the net diff against the merge base `4feccc268` (428 added, 41 removed; `origin/main` holds byte-identical copies of every touched path, the two changesets included, so the net diff against `origin/main` reads the same), and `git diff 17458f50d a72b7acf8` (2 files, 2 added, 2 removed, both changesets); the check-runs on the head and the Check Changeset job log, read once. The provider dist was read from the dev worktree's `node_modules`. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. The diff.** `type: Field.select(['web', 'native', 'user-agent-based', 'public'], …)` becomes `Field.select(['web', 'native'], …)` at `:462` of the object file, with `label`, `required: false`, `defaultValue: 'web'` and `group` unchanged; the action comment (`:159`-`:161`) and a new field comment; the four bundles drop `useragentbased` and `public` under `sys_oauth_application.fields.type.options` and keep the translated `web` / `native` leaves; half 2b's four-option describe is removed; two new test files; one new changeset; one corrected pending changeset. `public: Field.boolean(…)` (`:469`) and `apiMethods: ['get', 'list']` (`:657`) are byte-identical to the merge base. `Field.select`'s string shorthand (`selectWithOptions`, field.zod.ts `:3067`-`:3073`) keeps the written string as `label` and derives `value` with `toSnakeCase` (`:3054`-`:3059`, which drops every character outside `[a-z0-9_]`), so the declared values are exactly `web` and `native`, each equal to its label (pinned), and #25013's stripping reaches neither.

**(a) Rows that exist today: every door, read in the code and matched to the pins.**
- Reads, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_oauth_application` and `/:id`, with any filter: the read path judges no option membership. The only `invalid_option` sites outside tests in `packages/objectql/src` and `packages/rest/src` are the record validator's write arm (`record-validator.ts:1502`-`:1521`) and `rule-validator.ts:3139`, a `visibleWhen` gate on a write; no filter normaliser judges a select value, so a list filtered on any `type` value answers as before. Pinned at the engine for all six stored values (`oauth-application-type-column.test.ts`, first describe). A `user-agent-based` row was already outside the declared set before the change and read fine, by the same mechanism.
- get-client: the provider's `getOAuthClient` returns `application_type` as stored; 1.7.3 branches on the value on no read (`grep -c user-agent-based` over its dist: 0). Pinned for all six.
- The provider's update paths: `/oauth2/update-client` and `/admin/oauth2/update-client` declare `application_type: z.enum(["web", "native"]).optional()` (`:2885`, `:2923`) and re-run `checkOAuthClient` over the stored client merged with the update (`:2420`), which refuses any `application_type` other than `web` / `native` (`:1770`). So a row holding `user-agent-based`, `useragentbased` or `public` answers `invalid_client_metadata` to an update that leaves its type in place, before and after this diff, and the engine is never reached; with `application_type: 'native'` in the same update the provider writes `native`, which the validator accepts. Both pinned. A `null` row: `applyOAuthClientRegistrationDefaults(client, "web")` (`:1757`) fills the blank before the check, so a rename is accepted, as before.
- toggle-disabled: the bridge (`auth-plugin.ts:2952`) writes `{ id, disabled, updated_at }` through the engine. `validateRecordInScope`'s update branch walks `Object.entries(data)` (`record-validator.ts:1989`), so a stored `type` is never judged by a write that leaves it out. Pinned for all six (`disabled` set, type unchanged).
- rotate-secret: the provider writes `client_secret` only; the same rule. Pinned for all six.
- Any engine write that leaves `type` out: the same rule, by construction. And no driver turns the option list into a column constraint: `builtin-column-collision.ts:106` records `options` as "validation + UI, no DDL", so a legacy row is not refused by the database on any dialect either.
- Inserts: every provider creation path runs `checkOAuthClient`, so the engine only ever sees `web`, `native`, or `null` from the client-metadata-document seam (`:1956`). Accepted before and after.
No door that works today with a stored row holding `web`, `native`, `user-agent-based`, `null`, `useragentbased` or `public` refuses it after the narrowing. The only movements are the served option list and the engine's verdict on a write that SENDS `useragentbased` or `public`. Judged right; it matches M1.

**(b) Retired values.** The new refusal is reachable only by an engine write that sends `type: 'useragentbased'` or `type: 'public'`. Writers read: the provider (the enum above, run on every creation and update path); the register wrapper (`auth-plugin.ts:3664`-`:3702`, which forwards `web` / `native` only and refuses any other present type with 400 before the provider); the toggle-disabled bridge (`disabled` only); the generic data API (`apiMethods: ['get', 'list']`; `api-exposure.ts:141` answers 405 to create, update and import); no seed or fixture in `examples/`, `packages/qa`, `packages/runtime` or `packages/cli` inserts into the table; HotCRM `main` has no reader or writer of the column; `git grep useragentbased origin/main` hits only the four bundles and the pin this PR removes. So no real writer reaches the refusal; it guards the declaration. Envelope: the select arm returns `invalid_option` naming the allowed list, the validator throws `VALIDATION_FAILED` (`record-validator.ts:239`), and the pin (`expectTypeRefused`) asserts `resolveThrownHttpError(thrown).code` equals `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `.status` equals 400, and `details.fields` equals exactly one `{ field: 'type', code: 'invalid_option' }`, with nothing stored, on insert and on update for all three values; `web`, `native` and `null` are accepted. Yes to both halves.

**(c) Generated outputs.**
- Translations: the four `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles are the regenerated carriers (each loses three option leaves and keeps the translated `web` / `native` ones, which is merge mode). The three `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` companions carry no `fields.type.options.*` entry (their only `sys_oauth_application` option entry is the form param's `params.type.options.web`), so they are unaffected, and `git grep useragentbased` finds no residue anywhere on the head. `check:i18n` sits in a Lint lane still in progress; the dev's local reading was "10 packages in sync".
- `/meta`: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_oauth_application` is served from the registry's object definition at request time (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`), not from a checked-in artefact, so it follows the declaration with nothing to regenerate.
- The register form: its `type` param carries its own literal options (`:178`-`:181`), `web` / `native` since #25011, untouched; pinned equal to the column's values.
- Generated references: `content/docs/references/` is generated from `packages/spec` and names no platform-object option; the upgrade-harness fixture manifests carry object counts only (`"sys_oauth_application": 0`); no checked-in artefact names a retired value. The docs-drift comment on the PR lists three hand-written pages that name the object; none names the type options.
Everything that carries the options is regenerated by its own tool or computed at request time. Yes.

**(d) `null` and the default.** `applyFieldDefaults` (`engine.ts:8005`-`:8009`) fills a field that is `undefined` OR an explicit `null`, and `insert` calls it (`:16117`, `:16122`) before validation; `update` calls it only for keys a readonly strip took (`:15273`), which `type` is not. So an insert sending `type: null` stores `web` and an update sending `null` stores `null`. This diff touches none of that; `defaultValue: 'web'` and `required: false` are unchanged and pinned. The PR body states exactly this (M3 and its Acceptance notes); the changeset says "the column stays optional and defaults to `web`, and a `null` type is a blank value", true in compressed form (a blank takes the default on insert); the pin accepts `web` or `null` on insert and asserts `null` on update. Kept unchanged and stated truthfully. Nit, no change required: the field comment's "It can also write `null` … so the column stays optional" names the registration seam, whose insert-time `null` the engine turns into `web`; the optional column is what the update-path `null` needs. Every behaviour the comment states is still true.

**2. The deliberate correction, sentence by sentence.** BEFORE is read at the merge base `4feccc268` (`git show`), AFTER at this head.

`.changeset/24773-oauth-form-types.md` (`@objectstack/platform-objects`: patch, frontmatter unchanged; one bullet rewritten, nothing else moves):
- BEFORE: "**Unchanged.** The stored `sys_oauth_application.type` column still lists all four values, so a row written under an earlier provider line keeps its value. The `public` column is unchanged."
  - "The stored `sys_oauth_application.type` column still lists all four values" is FALSE on this head: `Field.select(['web', 'native'], …)` at `:462`, two served options (the new pin; M1 after). This is the falsifying fact.
  - "so a row written under an earlier provider line keeps its value": the conclusion stays TRUE (no row is read or rewritten by the diff; a `user-agent-based` row's reads are pinned), but its "so" tied it to the four-valued list, which is gone.
  - "The `public` column is unchanged." is TRUE: byte-identical, pinned.
- AFTER: "**Unchanged.** A row written under an earlier provider line keeps its stored type, and the `public` column is unchanged; the stored column's options narrow to Web and Native in this release's `sys_oauth_application.type` entry."
  - "A row written under an earlier provider line keeps its stored type": TRUE (above).
  - "the `public` column is unchanged": TRUE.
  - "the stored column's options narrow to Web and Native in this release's `sys_oauth_application.type` entry": TRUE. The options are `web` and `native`; the entry it points at is this PR's changeset, whose title opens with `sys_oauth_application.type`; both are pending notes for `@objectstack/platform-objects`, consumed by the same `changeset version`. The capitalised names follow this note's own prose ("offers Web and Native"); the entry it points at spells the stored values.
  - The label "**Unchanged.**" now heads two unchanged facts and a cross-reference, the shape the #25038 correction of this same bullet already took. Acceptable.
- Every unedited sentence stays true against this diff: the title; the `Clause-②: no (a form's offering: …)` line, read against `readArmToken` (`clause2-line.mjs:280`-`:293`): the parenthetical opens with `a`, no arm is read, and the Check Changeset run counts exactly one declared-breaking changeset, this PR's own; the history sentence; "The form now offers Web and Native, and still defaults to Web."; the two help bullets; the translations line. No still-true sentence was lost: the removed clause was the false one, and its true consequence is kept.

`.changeset/25053-oauth-application-type-options.md`, the sentence that refers to it (rewritten in `a72b7acf8`):
- BEFORE (`17458f50d`): "This entry supersedes the register-form entry's sentence that the stored column still lists all four values." True at `17458f50d`, where that sentence still stood; on this head it would point at a sentence that no longer exists.
- AFTER: "The register-form entry in this release refers to this entry for the stored column's options." TRUE: the corrected bullet refers to "this release's `sys_oauth_application.type` entry".
- The rest of this note, judged against the head: the title (two values, one writer) true; the `Clause-②: no (narrowing) — …` line true (the served and judged set loses exactly `useragentbased` and `public`, which no writer produces); the paragraph true fact by fact (provider writes `web` / `native` / no type, `:1757`, `:1770`, `:1956`; the generic API cannot write, `:657`; four options served through the hyphen-stripping shorthand; `user-agent-based` never a declared value); FROM true (the validator accepted both values against the four-valued list; the dev's ablation leg 2 shows it); TO true (the envelope in (b); "No door sends one" per (b); "`400` at an HTTP boundary" is the error's declared status, and the same sentence says no HTTP door reaches it, the generic one answering 405); Unchanged true clause by clause ((a) and (d); "as it did before" for the provider's update path is `:2420` on the installed line, which this diff does not touch); The fix true and pinned.

**3. The pins.** `sys-oauth-application.type-options.test.ts` (5): the option set with label equal to value; `required: false` and `defaultValue: 'web'`; parity with the form's param; all four bundles exactly `web` / `native`; the `public` column. `oauth-application-type-column.test.ts` (39): the doors in (a) for all six stored values, the provider's update path both ways, the refusal envelope of (b) on insert and update for three values, acceptance of `web`, `native` and `null`. `oauth-register-form-types.test.ts`: the four-option describe is removed and `optionValues` is still used by the form pin (`:60`), so nothing dangles. The plugin-auth file reaches `@objectstack/platform-objects` through the auth manifest, a pair `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` lists (`check-test-source-alias.mjs:499`-`:501`), and reads no file outside its package.

**4. The console.** `SelectCellRenderer` (objectui `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` at the pinned `cf153eb2e`, `:1888`, `:1910`-`:1928`) matches a value to an option exactly, then case-insensitively, and renders an unmatched value as `humanizeLabel(String(val))`; an empty value renders the placeholder. A `user-agent-based` row matched no option before (the value was `useragentbased`) and matches none after; a `useragentbased` / `public` row, which no writer produces, now renders humanised instead of with an option label. The record has no edit door (405). Matches M4.

### ② Semver level

- What publishes: `@objectstack/platform-objects` (not `private`) ships the narrowed declaration in its `dist`, and with it the option set `/meta` serves and the accept set the validator judges for `sys_oauth_application.type` narrow. Under `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` that is BREAKING. No ADR-0087 conversion carries it: no spec key, authorable spelling, object name or stored shape moves; the object is `lock: 'full'`, so no tenant overlay authors its field options; the rows are provider-written data, outside `objectstack migrate meta`. So under the amended 「甲」 rule (#6015 `6303865025`, as #25038 applied it) it ships now as a BREAKING `minor` with `!` in the title, the **BREAKING** banner and `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: the `24813-adopt-orphans-readonly-package` and `24773-oauth-type-refusal` shape, matched line for line. The marker's "The fix" bullet prescribes a request value, not a code rewrite, and the gate's prescription detector accepted it.
- The Check Changeset run on this head reads the same: `check-adr-0087-registration` prints "1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition" and reads this one as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; `check-changeset-no-major` prints "no `major` bump", and its LEVEL AXIS prints "this PR declares clause-② `no (narrowing)`, and no package whose published source it moves is graded `patch`". So `minor` is what the axis requires here as well as the precedent; the dev's deviation 3 read the axis as standing down for a `no` declaration, and the run shows it judged the arm.
- The PR body's `Clause-②: no (narrowing): …` and the changeset's `Clause-②: no (narrowing) — …` carry the same arm and reason; `readArmToken` reads `(narrowing)` on both spellings.
- The corrected `24773-oauth-form-types.md` keeps `patch` and `Clause-②: no (a form's offering …)`: its own change is still a form's offering and help text, which moves no accept set, and the new cross-reference adds no act of its own. Its level still matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in the dev report `6313194098`.
- Dev deviations, each answered: (1) the row and refusal pins in `plugin-auth` rather than beside the identity tests: accepted, `platform-objects` cannot import `@objectstack/objectql` (the cycle is recorded in its `plugin.test.ts`), the file sits where the object already runs on a real engine, and the declaration pin does sit beside the identity tests; (2) the action comment and the removed four-option describe: right, both were made false by the diff; (3) `minor` with `!`: right, and required by the level axis (②); (4) one merge of `origin/main` `4feccc268`, none since: every touched path is byte-identical between the merge base and `origin/main` apart from this PR's own changeset edits, so nothing moved under the diff; (5) full suites at `2d158a9dd`, the two new files and the dogfood battery at `17458f50d`, nothing re-run at `a72b7acf8`: accepted, `a72b7acf8` changes two changeset lines only; (6) M1 in-process with a deleted probe: the diff carries no probe (10 paths, none under `packages/qa`); (7) the ablation preflight's tree reading exit 3: a tooling-input note; its dist reading and the restore's `--absent` reading passed; (8) six engine WARN lines per run: the engine's own refusal logging, and the test silences `console.warn`; (9) model-free trailers and the session-URL footer: AGENTS' form; (10) the vanished pid file: a process note, the recorded pid was waited on.
- Out-of-scope finding 1 (the stale pending sentence) is resolved by the correction in `a72b7acf8`, confirmed in ① 2; this record is its written confirmation. Finding 2 (an insert sending `null` stores `web`) is accepted as noted, not filed: the seam is wired nowhere in this composition (`registerClientMetadataDocument` is imported by nothing in `plugin-auth/src`), the behaviour predates the PR, and it is the engine's documented default rule for an explicit `null` on insert (`engine.ts:8005`). It becomes a card only if that seam is wired.
- Owed before ACCEPT, for the seat, outside the diff: the PR body is stale at this head in three places. Acceptance notes bullet 1 says "This PR does not edit it" and "Its own changeset says it supersedes that sentence", both false since `a72b7acf8` (the file is edited, and the changeset now says "refers to"); the Gates section says `check-empty-changeset`: "no merge-base changeset modified or deleted", false at this head, where it is red by design. No patch-round report has been posted on #25053 for `a72b7acf8`, and the claim `6311507729`'s file surface was not widened in writing to `.changeset/24773-oauth-form-types.md`; the review brief names the correction as the seat's intended DELIBERATE CORRECTION, which this record confirms, so the seat's ACCEPT should carry that widening and the body edits.
- Pre-existing, not this PR's: the header comment of `oauth-register-form-types.test.ts` (`:13`-`:15`, lines this diff leaves alone) still says "the route still accepts them, so this is the form only", which #25038's refusal made false on `main` before this PR. For the seat's next `platform-objects` pass.
- Scope held: no `packages/spec/**`, no workflow, no governed surface, no provider or register-route code; the form's param untouched; the `public` column untouched. #25013 is named and not touched; both values are hyphen-free, so the shorthand stores each as written, pinned by label equal to value.
- **Check-runs on `a72b7acf8`**, read once, when the head's two workflow runs were two to three minutes old (38 runs):
